components.name: Primary Button
components.description: System Blue fill; one per view, for the action that moves the user forward.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn ds-btn-primary"><svg width="15" height="15" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.75" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg>New application</button>
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 8px; font: 550 13px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Mona Sans Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease, transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--accent, #0b63ce); color: var(--accent-ink, #fff); border: 1px solid transparent; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-hover, #0a56b3); } .ds-btn:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #0b63ce); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Default Button
components.description: Quiet translucent button with a hairline; every non-primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-default { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--line, rgba(15,23,38,0.09)); background: var(--btn-bg, rgba(255,255,255,0.72)); color: var(--ink, #0f1726); font: 550 13px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Mona Sans Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease, transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-btn-default:hover { background: var(--btn-bg-hover, #fff); border-color: var(--line-strong, rgba(15,23,38,0.16)); } .ds-btn-default:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-default:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #0b63ce); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Translucent field, blue border and 3px halo on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 240px; height: 34px; padding: 7px 10px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, rgba(15,23,38,0.16)); background: var(--input-bg, rgba(255,255,255,0.8)); color: var(--ink, #0f1726); font: 400 13.5px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Mona Sans Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; caret-color: var(--accent, #0b63ce); transition: border-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--ink-3, #5c6577); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--accent, #0b63ce); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #0b63ce) 20%, transparent); }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Shared track for the theme switch and the sheet tabs.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; padding: 2px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--seg-bg, rgba(15,23,38,0.06)); } .ds-seg button { height: 28px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: none; color: var(--ink-3, #5c6577); font: 550 13px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Mona Sans Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-seg button:hover { color: var(--ink, #0f1726); } .ds-seg .ds-seg-on { background: var(--seg-active, #fff); color: var(--ink, #0f1726); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,38,0.14); } .ds-seg button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #0b63ce); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-card { width: 220px; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--surface, rgba(255,255,255,0.82)); border: 1px solid var(--line, rgba(15,23,38,0.09)); box-shadow: 0 1px 1px rgba(15,23,38,0.05); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Mona Sans Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #0f1726); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease, transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-card:hover { background: var(--surface-hover, #fff); border-color: var(--line-strong, rgba(15,23,38,0.16)); } .ds-card:active { transform: scale(0.985); } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-co { margin: 2px 0 0; font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--ink-2, #444e60); } .ds-foot { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin-top: 8px; min-height: 24px; } .ds-score { font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink-2, #444e60); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-state { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 550; color: var(--accent, #0b63ce); }

components.name: Glass Lane
components.description: Neutral frosted lane; glass on ::before so the lane has no stacking context; 7px status dot.
components.css: .ds-lane { position: relative; width: 240px; min-height: 160px; border-radius: 14px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Mona Sans Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-lane::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1; border-radius: inherit; background: var(--glass, rgba(255,255,255,0.52)); backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(140%); border: 1px solid var(--glass-border, rgba(255,255,255,0.65)); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 var(--edge, rgba(255,255,255,0.9)), 0 1px 1px rgba(15,23,38,0.04), 0 10px 30px -14px rgba(15,23,38,0.22); transition: background-color 200ms ease; } .ds-lane:hover::before { background: var(--glass-strong, rgba(247,249,252,0.9)); } .ds-lane-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 12px 14px 8px; } .ds-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 999px; background: #0ea5e9; } .ds-lane-head h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink, #0f1726); } .ds-count { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--ink-3, #5c6577); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.css: .ds-figure { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 2px; margin: 0; color: var(--good, #047857); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Mona Sans Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-figure strong { font-size: 48px; line-height: 1; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: -0.04em; } .ds-figure span { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--ink-3, #5c6577); }

narrative.overview:
A professional tool, not a showpiece. The board has Linear's density and the material polish of macOS and visionOS. Glass is what the chrome is made of: a floating top bar, six full-height lanes and a side sheet. Each is a neutral frosted pane over one cool, single-tone backdrop lit softly from above. Colour is reserved for the things that need the user. Everything else stays in three greys of ink.

The system replaces an earlier "status is light" world (lanes tinted in rainbow hues, light pools behind each lane, an ink-coloured primary pill), which the user rejected as looking vibecoded. Nothing from that world survives except the brand mark. Neither theme is secondary: light and dark are both full token sets, chosen by a System/Light/Dark switch. An inline script in `index.html` applies the choice before first paint.
keyCharacteristics: One cool backdrop (light #dde3eb, dark #0e131c) with a single radial light from above the viewport.
Neutral frosted panes (blur 24px, saturate 140%), each with a 1px top edge highlight.
One accent, system blue. Red marks failures. Hue appears nowhere else.
Status is shown by a 7px dot. Lanes are never tinted.
The resume renders as white Helvetica paper in both themes.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Blue means "act here" or "this is live". Never use it for decoration, headings or idle state.

rules.name: The Spent-Only-Where-Needed Rule
rules.body: Tone colours belong to the score figure, status hues belong to the dot, and red belongs to failures. If a hue appears anywhere else, it is a defect.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Counts, scores and tallies always use `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`.

rules.name: The Lifted Pane Rule
rules.body: This is the signature interaction. A card being dragged turns into its own glass pane (`glass`, `blur(18px) saturate(160%)`, Lift shadow, scale 1.02) and floats over the board.

rules.name: The Unstacked Lane Rule
rules.body: The lane's glass lives on a `::before` layer at `z-index: -1`. The lane itself must never create a stacking context: no `z-index`, `transform`, `filter`, `opacity < 1` or `backdrop-filter` on it. Otherwise the fixed-position dragged card gets trapped in the lane or painted under later lanes.

rules.name: The Fallback Rule
rules.body: When reduced transparency is requested, `--glass` falls back to `--glass-strong` and backdrop blur is removed from panes, lanes and the dragged card. When `backdrop-filter` is unsupported, `--glass` also becomes `--glass-strong`. The glass must still read as solid surfaces in both cases.

dos: Do spend System Blue only on primary actions, "needs you" or live states, focus and selection.
Do keep lanes neutral and show status only with the 7px dot.
Do separate sections inside sheets with 1px hairlines (`line`).
Do keep the lane glass on `::before` and leave `.lane` without a stacking context.
Do swap the drop-target lane to `glass-strong`, and fall back to `glass-strong` under reduced transparency or without backdrop-filter support.
Do write only the unprefixed `backdrop-filter`. The build's lightningcss pass adds `-webkit-backdrop-filter` itself.
Do keep motion at 320ms or less. Presses scale and reduced motion removes movement.
Do render the resume as white Helvetica paper that matches the PDF, in both themes.
donts: Don't tint lanes or cards by status, and don't place light pools behind lanes. That was the rejected "status is light" world.
Don't put tone colours anywhere but the analysis score figure.
Don't use red for anything but failures, destructive actions and the analysis's red flags.
Don't nest cards or boxed panels inside a sheet.
Don't hand-write `-webkit-backdrop-filter`. When both were written by hand, the lightningcss minifier dropped the unprefixed declaration.
Don't put `backdrop-filter` on the scrim, because it kills the sheet's blur.
Don't give a card more than one state line.
